description: This Java source file defines the GithubOAuth2ClientMapper class, which extends AbstractOAuth2ClientMapper and implements OAuth2ClientMapper. It handles OAuth2 authentication with GitHub, including retrieving user email addresses via GitHub API calls, and creating or retrieving SecurityUser instances based on OAuth2 data.

classes.name: GithubOAuth2ClientMapper
classes.description: A class that maps OAuth2 authentication data from GitHub to internal SecurityUser objects, handling email retrieval via GitHub API.

classes.name: GithubEmailsResponse
classes.description: A list wrapper for GithubEmailResponse objects representing the email responses from GitHub API.

classes.name: GithubEmailResponse
classes.description: Represents individual email information from GitHub, including email address, verification status, primary status, and visibility.

methods.name: getOrCreateUserByClientPrincipal
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a SecurityUser based on OAuth2 authentication token and client info.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Synchronously fetches the primary email address from GitHub API using the provided email URL and OAuth2 token.
